entries.behavior: Exporting > export folder exposes the original Default export directory path and browse controls. Text and picker results remain staged until options Apply; cancel/closed-owner callbacks cannot change stored defaults. Blank/whitespace input clears the preference; nonblank literal spaces and Unicode paths are retained. Legacy YAML export_path portable values resolve against the source database, and native relative entries resolve against its database. New real manual-export panels read the configured shared directory instead of a separate last-used preference, render filenames there, and keep it after one-off destinations. A blank preference resolves and creates the home hydrus_export folder, including Windows USERPROFILE fallback when HOME is unavailable. Export phrase persistence merges against current settings in the writer so it retains directory changes.
